newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to add 2400-2800 eateries in '97.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to add 2400-2800 eateries in '97.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Thursday it plans to add 2,400 to 2,800 restaurants globally in 1997, with increased emphasis on full-size traditional restaurants and international locations.
More than 70 percent of 1997 openings will be outside the United States, it said.

"We were not satisfied with U.S. operating performance in 1996, which fell short of our goals in a highly competitive, changing consumer environment. In 1997, our focus will be squarely on improving sales at existing restaurants through improvements in marketing, service and menu," said Jack Greenberg, vice chairman and chairman-U.S.A.
"We will open fewer U.S. restaurants in 1997 and increase our emphasis on rebuilding and relocating existing restaurants," he said.
Improved results are expected but may not be realized until later in the year and into 1998, he said.
